entities.summary: Yeshivat Kerem B'Yavne is a major yeshiva in southern Israel. Located near the city of Ashdod and adjacent to Kvutzat Yavne, it falls under the jurisdiction of Hevel Yavne Regional Council. In 2024 it had a population of 520.
